items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: I’ll use Bucky on some of my jobs where it’s just myself, Bucky and Jerry Bruno. ... And we do a few things

ctx.x: Oh he’s got — well have you seen the new one? He’s got the Jazz Cat now. I have one of those too. It’s only 23 pounds, it’s a new one, and that’s light too and I’ll carry that around too. As long as you get the sound that you want. If you’re going to play with a big five, six pieces, then it’s hard to use a small amp. It’s very hard. And I use Bucky on some of my jobs where it’s just myself, Bucky and Jerry Bruno. I guess you’ve heard of Jerry, he plays bass. And we do a few things and I’ll use my Epiphone and he…
Any particular horn players that you enjoyed working with, sax or brass players that really stuck out.
